verdict.rationale: The RTX 5080 ships with companion software (the NVIDIA app, G-Assist, drivers), so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents any setting for disabling telemetry or usage tracking. The 'fully private' claim about running AI models locally is an adjacent feature, not a telemetry opt-out control, so it earns no credit.
